messages:
maya: Heads up 120 there's an oversized wooden crate and an e-scooter in the lobby. Crate labeled 'Art - Handle with care' but no host listed. Anyone expecting? :truck:
frontdesk-bot: Incoming delivery logged: DEL-4512, desc='wood crate (art)', status=held, handler=Kris
frontdesk-bot: Visitor check-in: rider=unknown, transport=e-scooter, badge_request=pending
leo: that's probably from the gallery vendor for our demo next week. i'll check slack DMs. can someone clear the small bench? it's full of people with laptops
devon: small poll: react with :bench: if you need the bench for the next 30m. i'll move from bench to kitchen table if needed
kate: i'm on the bench rn finishing a call, can move in 10m. on crate: pls keep it away from heat (it has oil paint smell)
maya: front desk, please don't open crate until we confirm chain-of-custody. also, can scooter be parked in storage-closet-2? it's blocking the doorway
frontdesk-bot: Scooter moved to storage-closet-2. Crate placed in secure-hold. Note: crate tag 'no host'
leo: pinging @artteam - @devin please confirm if you ordered the crate
devon: not me. @maria in procurement—anyone know?
kate: shipping label has company 'Oddities & Co' - we had a vendor phone call last month. maybe from demo partner. i'll DM procurement
maya: badge printer is giving a yellow light again. front desk, any quick tip?
frontdesk-bot: Badge printer advisory: low_ink_warning. Temporary workaround: print guest pass on the kiosk. Command: ```kioskctl print-temp "Guest"```
leo: kiosk printed a temp pass. guest (rider) is now wearing pass and sitting by elevator. Says their name is Jonah and they're visiting for an install check
maya: great. facilities, can someone label the crate "hold - arts" and add a sticky about "do not open without host"? we've had a misunderstanding before :grimacing:
facilities: Ticket FACL-231 created: "Label and move art crate to secure storage; add do-not-open sticker" assigned to @facilities_team, eta=1 business day
devon: also FYI stroller left near crate - probable vendor demo. moved stroller to storage to avoid tripping hazard. small win :thumbsup:
kate: kudos to Kris at front desk for handling scooter and crate logistics swiftly :clap:
leo: quick reminder: if guests bring non-food items (plants/art) please add a note in the package log about "scent/chemicals". saved us from a paint spill last year
maya: noted. can someone also add a small sign by the lobby that says "Please label packages & list host"? we're collecting a lot of mystery crates lately :memo:
frontdesk-bot: Suggestion logged: facilities suggestion - "lobby package labeling sign" ticket #FO-418
devon: Jonah (guest) said he might need a 10min power outlet by the window. i cleared a chair and put a sign 'reserved 10m'
leo: thanks. end of thread — crate in secure-hold, scooter stored, badge issued, sticker ticket created. :white_check_mark:
